title: Glenn Gaffney blocked transfer of NHI material to Bigelow
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Glenn Gaffney blocked transfer of NHI material to Bigelow, about 2008-2010 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Now you have all this congressional testimony that he specifically, you know, blocked >> this, uh, you know, moving of exotic, you know, non-human origin technology that was under locked, uh, that was supposed to go to Bigalow Aerospace in 2008.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there is congressional testimony that a man named Glenn Gaffney blocked a plan in 2008 to move exotic technology of non-human origin, held under lock and key, to Bigelow Aerospace, a private space company. He credits a report he calls the historical report, volume one. Michels tells it because, if true, it would mean such material exists and someone inside the government chose to keep it hidden.
